2. Authorship-assertion flake (bug f94e-cf09-fed7-422d) — FILED (already tracked; real test-assertion bug, not environmental).
3. S5 plan-review advisory 'AST census may not resolve workflow/runs.py mode=mode (branch-bound variable)' — ACCEPTED: runs.py routes structured work through the get_runner().run() facade regardless of census mode-resolution, so the single-source guarantee holds; the runtime funnel/contract test (test_runner_funnels_structured_through_one_operation_but_text_bypasses_it) proves dispatch is single-sourced behaviorally. Non-blocking.
4. S5 plan-review advisory 'filename/count census assertions are source-structural' — ACCEPTED: intentional per AC-1's stated rationale (the census IS the enumerable single-source proof); complemented by the runtime funnel test.
5. S5 LLM-Review ps1 advisories (AC-1 census tests source-structural) — FIXED in scope: added the runtime contract test in ps2; remaining advisory accepted as above.
6. S4 landing advisories — DEFERRED with S4 (landed green, LLM-Review+1 AND Verified+1).
Surface-parity (AC-1 census): all mode='structured' consumers (library/CLI/MCP/in-tree callers) proven to route through the one-operation facade — no out-of-scope parity slot remains.
